exercises.why: **скроют** — скрыть (perfective): to hide, to conceal; to dissemble, to keep back; to keep secret. Wiktionary: с- + крыть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **прикрыл** — прикры́ть (perfective): to cover, to screen, to close / shut softly; to protect, to shelter, to cover, to shield; to cover up, to conceal; (colloquial) to liquidate, to close down. Wiktionary: при- + крыть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **прикрыт** — прикры́ть (perfective): to cover, to screen, to close / shut softly; to protect, to shelter, to cover, to shield; to cover up, to conceal; (colloquial) to liquidate, to close down. Wiktionary: при- + крыть.

exercises.why: **покрывает** — покрыва́ть (imperfective): to cover; to drown out; (agriculture) to mount (an animal to mate); to extend (to possess a certain extent; to cover an amount of space). Wiktionary: покры́ть + -ва́ть.
